title: Helping health datawork together.
text:
Public health physician · data scientist
        Helping health datawork together.
        I'm a public health physician and data scientist. Most of my work these days is in digital health at Malaysia's Ministry of Health — health-data interoperability and enterprise analytics — alongside ongoing research in epidemiology and infectious disease.
        
          Explore the work
          Download CV
        
        
          27Publications
          18First author
          40+Talks / workshops
        
      
      
        
          
          
        
      
    
  






I believe it’s within the synergism between data and compassion that we find a better future — so I try to shorten the distance between evidence and action across infectious disease and the health system. Recent work spans COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness, dengue and HFMD forecasting, excess-mortality estimation, and health-data interoperability at national scale.
